what: Nine scripted answering policies against two rewards on the edition-aware question set; no model.
earlier_reward: composite() of rl-env/frc_citation/rewards.py as shipped: key number present, at least one valid receipt anywhere, forgery and red-line penalties, clipped to [0, 1]

policies.policy: honest, with the figure's own receipt
abstain ("I don't have a verified figure")
policies.test: knowledge-free policy earns at least 90% of the honest policy
knowledge-free policy earns at least 90% of the honest policy

policies.policy: wrong value + the question's real receipt (authority laundering)
policies.test: knowledge-free policy earns at least 90% of the honest policy

policies.policy: wrong value + some other valid receipt
policies.test: knowledge-free policy earns at least 90% of the honest policy
attachment raises the reward of a right answer that has no receipt of its own
attachment raises the reward of a right answer that has no receipt of its own

policies.policy: first-printed value given as the latest (only where a later edition differs)
policies.test: knowledge-free policy earns at least 90% of the honest policy

break_even_without_source: under the bound reward, answering without a receipt beats abstaining only above 56% accuracy (0.5 / 0.9)
limits: Scripted policies only: the audit shows these exploits fail, not that no exploit exists. The reward checks numbers and receipts, not the wording around them; the sentence gate does that separately.
